description: Get options chain data and Greek exposure analysis for a stock ticker. Includes spot price, available expiration dates, key levels (gamma flip, call/put walls, max pain, net GEX, bullish score, implied move, P/C OI ratio, total OI/volume), human-readable positioning insights, and per-strike net Greek exposure profiles. Supported Greeks: gamma, vanna, charm, delta, theta, vega. Useful for analyzing options market positioning, dealer hedging flows, and identifying key support/resistance levels.

expiration.description: Specific expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for nearest available expiration.

greeks.description: Comma-separated Greek metrics to include. Valid: gamma, vanna, charm, delta, theta, vega, or 'all'. Default: 'gamma'

maxStrikes.description: How many strikes to show per greek, chosen nearest to the spot price (the most trade-relevant ones). Higher = more complete gamma/greek profile but more tokens; lower = faster, cheaper, easier for small-context models. Default: 12 (compact). Use ~40 for the full profile, or ~6 for a quick glance. Key Levels and Insights are always included regardless.

name: get_options_data
